data.name: Rizaan
data.gender_notes: Rizaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is content and satisfied. The name Rizaan carries the meaning “Content, Satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Rizaan usually hope their child will grow to embody content, satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is spiritually content and satisfied
data.etymology: Rizaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Content, Satisfied.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rizaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ريزان
in_arabic.meaning: ريزان يعني الثبات و الاستقرار و القوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريزان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ز-ن' والذي يعني الثبات و الاستقرار. و يدل على القوة و الصبر. و قد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية ٧٨ 'وَأَثْبَتْنَاهُ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِن رَبِّهِ' حيث تشير إلى الثبات و الاستقرار. و يعتبر اسم ريزان من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و قيمة روحية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رضوان
in_urdu.meaning: رضوان کا مطلب ہے ثبات، استحکام، اور مضبوطی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رضوان نام عربی جڑ 'ر-ض-و' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ثبات، استحکام، اور مضبوطی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں مقبول ہے اور ثبات و استحکام کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، رضوان نام روحانی معانی اور اعلیٰ قیمتیں رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रिज़ान
in_hindi.meaning: रिज़ान का अर्थ है स्थिरता, दृढ़ता और शक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिज़ान नाम अरबी मूल 'र-ज़-न' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है स्थिरता, दृढ़ता और शक्ति। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इसका उपयोग किया जाता है। रिज़ान नाम धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: رضوان
in_pashto.meaning: رضوان د ثبات، استحکام او پیاوړتیا معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رضوان نوم د عربي کلمې 'ر-ض-و' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د ثبات، استحکام او پیاوړتیا معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتون قومونو په دود کې د روحاني معنا او لوړو ارزښتونو سره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Rizaan
in_english.meaning: Rizaan means stability, strength, and power in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rizaan is derived from the Arabic root 'r-z-n', which signifies stability, strength, and power. This root is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing steadfastness. Rizaan is a name rich in spiritual significance, symbolizing resilience and firmness. It is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its importance in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rizaan holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world as it reflects a person's character and values. The name is derived from the Arabic root "rz," which means contentment or satisfaction. In Islamic culture, contentment and satisfaction are highly valued virtues as they are believed to lead to inner peace and happiness. The name Rizaan represents an individual who possesses these qualities and strives to find contentment in all aspects of life, including in their relationships, material possessions, and spiritual beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rizaan holds a deep significance as it is a constant reminder of the importance of finding contentment and satisfaction in Allah (God). The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) taught that true happiness and peace come from pleasing Allah and seeking His pleasure above all else. The name Rizaan encourages its bearer to focus on the eternal rewards of pleasing Allah and finding inner peace and tranquility through faith and obedience to His commands. Thus, the name Rizaan has a spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition as it inspires individuals to strive for a closer relationship with Allah and find ultimate satisfaction in Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Content, Satisfied" symbolizes The one who is content and satisfied. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rizaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of content, satisfied.

modern_usage.modern_context: Rizaan is a common name among Muslims, particularly in South Asia and the Middle East. It is derived from the Arabic word 'razana' which means 'contented' or 'satisfied'. In modern usage, the name Rizaan is used as a given name for both males and females.
